summary:
Prana-Netra – Mission Health Intelligence

Prana-Netra is a space-health monitoring project designed to help monitor astronaut health during space missions. It aims to provide a centralized view of crew wellbeing by organizing health-related information and making it easier to understand. The concept focuses on observing health signals, identifying patterns, tracking changes and presenting useful insights. It addresses challenges such as microgravity, isolation and limited access to medical support in space. By supporting timely awareness and communication between astronauts and ground teams, Prana-Netra aims to improve health monitoring and mission preparedness. Its broader vision is to make space exploration safer through technology-driven health intelligence.

details: Project Details: Prana-Netra Prana-Netra is a Mission Health Intelligence project focused on astronaut health monitoring during space missions. It aims to provide a centralized system for collecting, organizing and understanding crew health information. The project concept focuses on monitoring health signals, identifying patterns, tracking changes and presenting meaningful insights through a user-friendly dashboard. It addresses challenges faced by astronauts, including microgravity, isolation and limited medical support. The system aims to improve communication between astronauts and ground teams, support early awareness of potential health concerns and assist mission planning. Its ultimate goal is to make space exploration safer through technology-driven health monitoring. Note: This describes the project concept, not verified implementation details.
